mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_application( member_id, product_id, request_id, application_status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{requestId}, #{applicationStatus} )
INSERT INTO loan_application_consent( application_id, terms_id, agreed_yn, agreed_at ) VALUES ( #{applicationId}, #{termsId}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT application_id, member_id, product_id, request_id, application_amount, birth_date, employment_type, annual_income, available_limit, estimated_interest_rate, loan_term, application_status FROM loan_application WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND application_status IN('작성중') AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC, application_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT application_id, member_id, product_id, application_amount, loan_term, employment_type, annual_income, birth_date, available_limit, estimated_interest_rate, application_status FROM loan_application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND application_status = '작성중' AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.update:
UPDATE loan_application
application_amount = #{request.applicationAmount},
loan_term = #{request.loanTerm},
employment_type = #{request.employmentType},
annual_income = #{request.annualIncome},
birth_date = #{request.birthDate},
updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND application_status = '작성중' AND is_deleted = 'N'

UPDATE loan_application SET application_status = '심사중', available_limit = #{availableLimit}, estimated_interest_rate = #{estimatedInterestRate}, applied_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND application_status = '작성중' AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT application_id, member_id, product_id, application_amount, birth_date, employment_type, annual_income, available_limit, estimated_interest_rate, application_status, loan_term, applied_at, created_at, updated_at FROM loan_application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT la.application_id, la.product_id, lp.product_name, la.application_amount, la.application_status, la.created_at, la.applied_at FROM loan_application la INNER JOIN loan_product lp ON la.product_id = lp.product_id
WHERE la.member_id = #{memberId} AND la.is_deleted = 'N' AND la.application_status IN ( '작성중', '심사중', '승인', '거절' ) ORDER BY la.created_at DESC, la.application_id DESC

SELECT la.application_id, la.product_id, lp.product_name, la.application_amount, la.loan_term, la.available_limit, la.estimated_interest_rate, la.employment_type, la.annual_income, la.birth_date, la.application_status, la.created_at, la.applied_at, la.reviewed_at, lp.max_loan_term FROM loan_application la INNER JOIN loan_product lp ON la.product_id = lp.product_id
WHERE la.application_id = #{applicationId} AND la.member_id = #{memberId} AND la.is_deleted = 'N'
